scope: Review changes since 22ab488, reproduce prior receiver controls, check new pin observation and frozen-input admission, and assess research progress. Production code unchanged.

prior_findings.limit: This checks the updated validator; historical transistor characterization waveforms were not replayed.

prior_findings.evidence: Current comparison report and cumulative status now use 12000/6000/3000 FV for Cases 1-5/6-8/9-10.
IHP contract now states 2.05/0.55 ns port budgets and treats the PVT-derived sensitivity as a conditional assumption.

findings.problem: The right-biased grid search assigns right/top die-boundary pins to filler or a neighboring die, whereas left/bottom boundary pins select the owning die. It ignores pin ownership at a material interface.
findings.impact: Importer accepts exactly +/-50 percent offsets. A centred symmetric 4 mm square die gives 62.189526 C at left/bottom pins and 49.351638 C at right/top pins, a 12.837888 K direction-dependent sampling error. The FV energy balance still passes, so conservation alone cannot detect the observation bug.
findings.published_result_scope: No exact boundary endpoints in the ten hash-matched imported cases; no demonstrated impact on the published 1340 layouts.
findings.fix_direction: Define boundary observation using the owning chiplet and select its one-sided cell (or a documented interface reconstruction), then verify reflection/rotation symmetry for boundary pins.

findings.problem: analyse does not compare case_path to the frozen summary case_sha256. The checks compare old NPZ metadata to old summary values and compare only the freshly solved peak, which is independent of pin offsets.
findings.impact: Changing only valid pin offsets from a 5 mm to a 3 mm net is accepted while the output still reports the old 0.005 m total length. The changed interconnect and pin-temperature result is attributed to the unchanged frozen summary.
findings.published_result_scope: All ten current local case hashes match the summaries and the report binds those summaries; this does not establish that historical runs used altered inputs.
findings.fix_direction: Enforce the already-frozen case hash before solving; recompute and compare the selected layout length to the frozen value. Reuse the existing same_problem identity pattern instead of adding another protocol layer.

checks.two_example_cli: validate two_chiplets and evaluate both two_chiplets/layered_two_chiplets passed; timing and external thermal validation remain not_run

published_interface_result.independent_replay_scope: Recomputed saved-result statistics and checked provenance against current local cases/front summaries; full per-net temperature/distance arrays are not in the compact report and original 1340 layouts are not present locally, so this is not a replay of all cost evaluations.

progress_assessment.stage: usable research core, ongoing bounded review
progress_assessment.evidence: 80 tests and two CLI examples pass; two new observation/input defects reproduced outside demonstrated published-result impact.

progress_assessment.stage: completed descriptive comparison in the declared model
progress_assessment.evidence: Case1-10, six methods, three paired seeds, 180 runs. Stronger length results from topology_lp; epsilon and topology_lp temperature medians are close. Stable temperature superiority not established; frozen comparison uses the older LP implementation.

progress_assessment.stage: reduced steady model numerically validated; target package validation incomplete
progress_assessment.evidence: Conservation, positive heat paths and boundary bookkeeping support the model implementation, not calibration of actual material/contact/convection parameters. Boundary-pin control demonstrates that a valid field can still be observed incorrectly.

Published 1340 candidate layouts and 180 parameter cells summarize to 90 unchanged, 90 indistinguishable, zero changes above 1 percent; maximum advantage 0.4033229 percent. This is not a statement that all optimum indices are identical.
Normalized max-net cost has no mapped full data/capture-clock path or achieved setup/hold slack. Endpoint-mean path temperature and uniform gamma remain assumptions; physical_qualified is false.

interpretation_limits: Saved statistics and provenance were independently checked; all 1340 per-net thermal calculations were not rerun because raw layout arrays are not local and per-net arrays are not in the compact report.

The front was selected by total pin length and peak temperature; this does not make it a complete candidate set for maximum temperature-weighted net delay. For example net lengths [10,1] and [6,6] can favor the first in total length but the second in maximum length. This is a mathematical scope illustration, not a measured layout result.
No change above the declared 1 percent resolution in sampled gamma values is a useful conditional negative result, not a proof over every gamma or a real PHY qualification.
next_bounded_actions: Fix boundary-pin observation and enforce the existing frozen case identity, with focused controls; do not rerun all 1340 layouts unless affected inputs are demonstrated.

Consolidate the six-method comparison around physical joint metrics and limitations. If implementing a topology_lp/epsilon combination, use one paired development seed before a justified three-seed comparison.

Keep real timing as a separate incomplete line. Before another timing campaign, define one sourced interface, reference planes, matched data/clock paths and receiver constraints; do not infer feasibility from normalized cost.
